get_torsion_indexes: get torsion indexes for an RDKit molecule using SMARTS pattern matching and mass-based neighbor selection
compute_dihedral_angle: compute the dihedral angle from four atom positions using PyTorch tensors and RDKit rotation conventions
check_torsions: verify that computed torsion angles match expected values by comparing sine and cosine values
reverse_dihedral_by_size: determine whether to reverse a dihedral angle based on fragment sizes after removing a bond
refactor_dihedral: refactor the dihedral angle computation to support batched tensor inputs for multiple molecules
